title: Bare chord — collision-free assignment from pitches alone
description: One whole-note chord (sounding C3 E3 G3 C4 E4 — the open C-major shape) with no annotations. Assignment runs highest-pitch-first so the crowded top strings choose first, and no two notes may share a string: the derived shape is exactly the open C chord — strings 1..5, frets 0 1 0 2 3. Proves the within-chord collision avoidance of the default algorithm.
